questions.text: If log10(x) + log10(x - 3) = 1, find the valid real value of x.
questions.explanation: log10(x(x-3)) = 1 => x^2 - 3x - 10 = 0 => (x-5)(x+2)=0. Domain requires x > 3, so x = 5.
